# riftgate -- Gloam rift gate (episode 4 spawner)
# generated by tools/sprites/build.py -- do not edit by hand
# glow: the rift, the neon edges, the lintel eye, plinth lights
# the engine sets attack only for the tick it spawns: hold it ~0.6 s to show the flare
frame 96 96
anchor 48 92
# idle: the rift turns, lights chase up the pylons
anim idle 8 loop 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
# attack: beaming in: the rift flares, arcs crackle
anim attack 12 loop 8 9 10 11 12 13 14 15
anim hurt 12 once 16 17 18
